verdict.rationale: Lago's entitlements platform page claims it combines billing with feature flags and manages entitlements and billing in one system, so the capability is asserted. The pack has no documentation showing how entitlements attach to plans or how an application checks them at runtime. missing for 10: documented attachment of features and limits to plans, a runtime entitlement-check API endpoint or SDK method, in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
